newsitem.title: USA: NuMED stake raised by Ohio investor.
newsitem.headline: NuMED stake raised by Ohio investor.

text.p: A Mentor, Ohio-based investment fund, Turkey Vulture Fund XIII Ltd, said Wednesday it raised its stake in NuMED Home Health Care Inc to 485,000 shares or 9.9 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the fund said it has requested the company's stockholder list "in order to communicate with the stockholders of NuMED concerning corporate affairs."
The fund most recently bought 95,000 NuMED shares between March 11 and April 1 at $1.25 to $1.50 a share, according to the SEC filing.
NuMED, based in Independence, Ohio, provides home health care and rehabilitative services.
